name: user_types_proceed_intent_text
goal: User types a proceed intent like 'proceed' or 'continue' to request employment letter.
constraints: Employee details must be present. User types a valid intent instead of selecting an option.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays correct employee details and options.
Bot proceeds to trigger mail workflow silently.

phases.description: Bot triggers mail and confirms success.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays the exact confirmation message for employment letter request.
